mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Equinox</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is rooted and cannot move.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Rejuvenation</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is recovering health and has increased Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Soraka gains <speed>@MovementSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> while moving towards allied champions who are below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_Consecration_Self_Tooltip}}

Allies must be within @CastRange@ range of Soraka.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Soraka creates a starfield that deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to champions. The field lingers for @RootDelay@ seconds, <status>Silencing</status> enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are <status>Rooted</status> for @RootDuration@ second(s) and take <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Soraka calls down a star, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slowing by @MoveSpeedSlow*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores @TotalHoT@ Health over @HoTDuration@ seconds and grants @MoveSpeedHaste*100@% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring <healing>@HealingCalc@ Health</healing> to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to <healing>@AmpedHealing@</healing> on targets below 40% Health.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Soraka restores @TotalHeal@ Health to another allied champion.

If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by @PercentHealthCostRefund*100@%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for @Spell.SorakaQ:HoTDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability cannot be used if Soraka is below @MinimumHealth@ Health .</rules>
